note: Wikimedia Commons, “St.Tit.jpg”; artist as recorded there: ієр.Іринарх та учні — fetched 04 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it «Ікона преподобного Тита Воїна. Київ. XIX ст.» — an icon of Venerable Titus the Warrior — and categorises it under 'Saints of Kyiv Caves Monastery'. Warrior and Caves together are this folder: saint.gr prints «Όσιος Τίτος ο στρατιώτης» and the Ohrid Prologue „Преподобни Тит Печерски“, a soldier wounded in the head who withdrew to the Caves and took the habit there. The epithet Воїн is precisely what separates him from Titus the presbyter of the same Lavra, which this folder's Serbian name note names as the distinction to make. Commons describes it: Ікона преподобного Тита Воїна. Київ. XIX ст. Ієр.Іринарх та учні.
